title: OrgAssignment
description: Defines an assignment of a user to a organizational unit.

id.description: The generated ID for this assignment.

customer_id.description: The customer ID of this organization

org_id.description: The unique ID of this organization

org_path.description: The unique ID of this organization

assigned_to.description: The unique ID of the entity this role is assigned to—either the userId of a user, the groupId of a group, or the uniqueId of a service account as defined in Identity and Access Management (IAM).

assignee_type.description: Output only. The type of the assignee (USER or GROUP).
